messages:
sam: Hey folks — provisioning request for a new prod account in eu-west-2 for the Pangea Dedicated rollout. We hit multiple storage/IO limits when trying to scale workers. Can we escalate quotas?

sam: Details below — need this within 4 business days if possible: 
```
Account: prod-pangea-eu
Region: eu-west-2
Requests:
- EBS gp3 total volumes: 200 -> 500
- Per-volume IOPS (gp3): 16k -> 64k (for checkpoint volumes)
- Snapshot concurrency API: 10/s -> 60/s
- EBS throughput quota (per account): 2.5 Gbps -> 6 Gbps
- NAT gateway / egress BW for subnet: 1 Gbps -> 4 Gbps
- GCS (eu-west4) object create rate: 5k/s -> 20k/s (we mirror some telemetry to GCS)
```

joyce: @sam thanks — do we have a list of affected instance IDs / volume ids and which pipelines will be blocked? Need to scope requests for support ticket. :eyes:

sam: quick summary: 3 services affected — checkpointing (ml-batch), nightly snapshots (archive), and cross-region mirroring. I can attach a CSV with sample volumes in the ticket. Also cost owner is eng-ml.

kevin: pinging AWS/GCP support contacts. Can you paste a copy-ready support request and I'll open it? Also need billing account id and linked project numbers for GCP.

sam: Copy for ticket (feel free to edit):
```
Hello, we need quota increases for account prod-pangea-eu in eu-west-2 to enable a scheduled rollout of dedicated GPU workers.
Impacted workloads: ML batch checkpointing, nightly snapshot pipeline, and telemetry export to GCS.
Requested increases: EBS gp3 volumes -> 500, per-volume IOPS up to 64k, snapshot API concurrency to 60/s, account EBS throughput 6 Gbps, NAT egress 4 Gbps.
We can provide example volume IDs and retention windows on request. Goal: complete change within 4 business days.
Regards, Sam (Infra/ML)
```

kevin: Submitted to AWS support case #1234567891 and GCP case 9876543210. AWS asked for a quick AMI load pattern and sample IOPS traces — toss those into the case comment. GCP flagged project: redwood-prod-pangea (I filed the obj-create increase request).

infra-bot: [auto] Case updated: AWS #1234567891 -> status: awaiting-customer. GCP 9876543210 -> status: in-progress. ETA from GCP: 72 hours.

sam: Thanks. Any short-term workarounds to avoid blocking rollout while quotas escalate?

kevin: Two quick options: 1) striping across multiple gp3 volumes (mdadm) to spread IOPS — we can script this in the launch userdata. 2) use instance-store NVMe for ephemeral checkpointing during the rollout to reduce snapshot frequency. Both increase operational complexity but buy time. Example for RAID0: 
```bash
sudo mdadm --create /dev/md0 --level=0 --raid-devices=2 /dev/nvme1n1 /dev/nvme2n1
sudo mkfs.xfs /dev/md0
```
Note: need backup plan if instance terminates.

joyce: Cost note — moving to higher per-volume IOPS and extra volumes will increase monthly spend. Recommend we tighten retention for nightly snapshots (30 -> 14 days) and review cold-storage lifecycle for older checkpoints. I'll sync with finance.

sam: Good call, I'll prepare a retention proposal and attach to the AWS/GCP cases. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll follow up on the AWS case after you drop the IOPS traces. Marking thread for follow-up when cases close. (reacted :raised_hands:)
